rgb.coverage_definition: valid source annotation AND identical SHA256 AND same modality; uncovered images never treated as negative

thermal.coverage_definition: valid source annotation AND identical SHA256 AND same modality; uncovered images never treated as negative

test_pairs.UV_role: fourth-column sensor input ONLY; never ground truth
test_pairs.scene_ground_truth: not supplied; no scene labels inferred

policy.split: deterministic greedy nearest 20 percent by SHA256-sorted group identifiers; whole burst/origin/hash groups
policy.reserved_policy: exclude exact reserved image hashes in BOTH modalities plus entire source temporal/augmentation/duplicate groups touching those hashes
policy.classes: observed fire / Fire explicitly case-normalized to fire; other names invalid and require human mapping
policy.box_policy: strict actual JPEG size and 0<=xmin<xmax<=width; no clipping or unverified coordinate shift
policy.ground_truth_policy: export candidates only if valid and identical SHA256 and nonconflicting source boxes

limitations: RGB numerical filenames do not identify videos/scenes; temporal independence cannot be certified; numeric adjacency is not invented video truth.
Filename timestamp bursts are heuristic, not verified video identifiers.
Nonidentical near-duplicates are not detected by SHA256; augmentation names are grouped where recognizable.
Source folder tags are not validated scene ground truth.
Configs are dataset fragments, not complete PPYOLOv2 model/training configs; no training performed.
JPEG header dimensions inspected with stdlib; full pixel decode/corruption verification not performed.
